system: You are Quillfold's support assistant. Today is {today}. Answer from the product team's feedback-triage memory in one or two sentences, starting with Yes, No or Unknown.
rule: No record that something happened is not a record that it did not happen. A decision in memory can carry a condition (unless, provided, only if, if, as long as). If memory holds no fact saying how a condition came out, answer No when its deadline has passed (the plan is not confirmed) or Unknown when it is still ahead, and say the outcome is not recorded: do not say that it happened, and do not say that it did not. If memory does record how it came out, answer from that record.
rule_fact: Rule for Quillfold's support assistant, for every conditional decision:

meetings.name: Feedback triage 7 Sep
lines: sup
We tell Halverson Logistics their CSV export fix ships on October 20, provided the fix passes QA on their 200,000-row file by October 14.
pm
We promise Brightwater Clinics SAML single sign-on in the November 2 release, as long as the Okta integration test passes by October 9.
eng
We switch off the v1 API on November 1, provided the last four customers still on it move to v2 by October 12.
ceo
And the public roadmap page launches on December 1.

meetings.name: Feedback triage 14 Sep
lines: pm
We build the Slack digest only if at least ten accounts vote for it on the feedback board.
pm
Bulk edit goes GA only if the beta error rate stays under 1 percent.
ceo
The new $49 Team plan price starts on October 27, as long as finance signs off the margin review by October 13.
sup
The customer webinar on December 4 goes ahead if at least 40 customers register by October 28.

meetings.name: Feedback triage 21 Sep
lines: pm
The Slack digest passed ten votes on Friday: twelve accounts have voted for it, so we are building it.

meetings.name: Feedback triage 15 Oct
lines: eng
The CSV export fix failed QA: Halverson's 200,000-row export still timed out at 90 seconds.
pm
The bulk edit beta error rate came in at 2.4 percent.
